args.query: upload big csv to s3 in chunks python without loading whole file into memory

results.title: Streaming CSV transform with csv-parse + csv-stringify
results.summary: Transform large CSV files without loading them into memory: csv-parse in columns mode, a Node Transform for row logic, csv-stringify output, wired with stream/promises pipeline.

results.title: Starlette multipart form uploads parsed with python-multipart, tested offline
results.summary: Parse multipart text fields and file uploads in Starlette with python-multipart, then exercise the app fully in-process through httpx.ASGITransport with no network.

results.title: AWS SDK v3 S3 storage helpers tested with aws-sdk-client-mock
results.summary: S3 helpers on @aws-sdk/client-s3 for JSON put/get with NoSuchKey handling, paginated listing, batched DeleteObjects and locally signed presigned URLs, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and sdkStreamMixin bodies.

results.title: CSV import with PapaParse + Zod row validation
results.summary: Parse CSV uploads with PapaParse (headers, BOM, quoted fields), validate each row with Zod and report row-numbered errors instead of failing the whole file.

results.title: boto3 S3 helper with paginated listing and presigned URLs, tested offline with moto
results.summary: A small boto3 S3 helper for upload, paginated listing, presigned GET URLs and batched delete, tested offline with moto's mock_aws and fake credentials.

results.title: Fastify 5 file uploads with @fastify/multipart
results.summary: Accept multipart file uploads in Fastify 5 with @fastify/multipart, reading fields and files, hashing content, rejecting oversized files with 413, tested with inject() and a native FormData body.

results.title: file-type buffer detection
results.summary: Detect PNG, PDF, ZIP and GIF from small in-memory magic byte buffers with file-type, asserting ext and mime, and undefined for plain text.

results.title: Typer CLI exporting Rich tables and CSV for batch reports
results.summary: A Typer command that aggregates a batch of CSV reports, renders a Rich table with escaped cells and formatted totals, and exports a machine-parseable CSV, tested offline with CliRunner.

results.title: Loading .env files with python-dotenv and pydantic-settings precedence rules
results.summary: Typed app settings from .env files with pydantic-settings, covering source precedence, layered env files, extra-key rules and python-dotenv override behavior, tested offline with tmp_path files.

results.title: SheetJS xlsx read and write workbooks in memory
results.summary: Build and parse Excel workbooks with SheetJS community xlsx: JSON sheet roundtrips, header rows, and AOA writes using in-memory buffers only.
